Any other similarities are standard proclamation form or generic presidential action.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the Columbia National Forest... is hereby designated and hereafter shall be known as the Gifford Pinchot National Forest","parent_excerpt":"the areas... are withdrawn from all forms of appropriation under the public-land laws and added to and reserved as part of the Channel Islands National Monument","explanation":"C19 is the closest land-related candidate, but it changes boundaries and legal land status rather than assigning a new name."},{"child_excerpt":"as defined by Executive Order No. 820... and as subsequently modified by Executive orders and acts of Congress","parent_excerpt":"which was withdrawn and set aside for military purposes by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE]... and which has not heretofore been restored","explanation":"C14 similarly identifies land through prior directives before changing its status, but that is ordinary legal-description practice and the operative machinery differs."},{"child_excerpt":"under and do hereby proclaim that... is hereby designated","parent_excerpt":"under and do hereby designate Sunday, May 15, 1949, as \"I Am An American Day\"","explanation":"C18 shares a designation formula, but this is generic proclamation language applied to a commemorative observance, not a material template for renaming a forest."}]}
